title: Agent-as-a-Verifier: From Scores to Evidence for General Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.34132v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Verification is increasingly critical across various inference and learning paradigms, such as test-time scaling, recursive intelligence and automated research, where feedback can improve efficiency and optimization. Common score-based verifiers, or discriminative reward models, predict a scalar reward for an output. While useful for filtering, rewarding, and ranking, such scores provide no explicit, auditable evidentiary basis for the judgment. In parallel, although existing generative process reward models offer text feedback, most designs do not fully exploit agentic capabilities, such as tool use and iterative reasoning, which are essential for fact-checking and fine-grained claim verification. In this paper, we address these limitations by introducing Agent-as-a-Verifier, an agentic, certificate-producing verification system that places role-separated LLM agents inside a formal-methods-inspired claim-obligation-certificate protocol.

translated_title: 验证器即智能体：从分数到证据的通用验证
translated_abstract: 验证在各种推理和学习范式中日益关键，例如测试时扩展、递归智能和自动化研究，在这些范式中，反馈能够提升效率与优化效果。常见的基于分数的验证器（即判别式奖励模型）为输出预测一个标量奖励。尽管这类分数对于过滤、奖励和排序很有用，但它们无法为判断提供明确且可审计的证据基础。与此同时，虽然现有的生成式过程奖励模型能够提供文本反馈，但大多数设计并未充分利用智能体能力，例如工具使用和迭代推理，而这些能力对于事实核查和细粒度声明验证至关重要。在本文中，我们通过引入“验证器即智能体”来解决这些局限性，这是一个能够产生证书的智能体验证系统，它将角色分离的LLM智能体置于受形式化方法启发的“声明-义务-证书”协议之中。
tldr: 该论文提出“验证器即智能体”系统，将角色分离的LLM智能体嵌入受形式化方法启发的声明-义务-证书协议中，使验证从仅输出分数升级为生成可审计的证据证书。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Agent-as-a-Verifier, an agentic, certificate-producing verification system that embeds role-separated LLM agents within a formal-methods-inspired claim-obligation-certificate protocol, upgrading verification from mere scalar scores to auditable evidence.
